Name: Change Shoe Color
Author: Shaklin
Description:
[left][size=3]With this mod you can change your shoe color directly in the game.[/size]

Simply go to the[i] inventory menu[/i] (ESC, Tab 1) or [i]Customize Menu[/i] (Wizard) and
click on the new arrows (with gamepad use left- and right shoulder).
It also works for the mods '[i]Get Glam[/i]' and '[i]CustomizeAnywhere[/i]'.

When you put a shoe back on, it has the original color again.
Then you have to choose your custom color again.[/left]
There are 15 vanilla colors.
I added some custom colors (assets/shoeColors.xnb), include all skin tones.

[size=3][b]Config.json:[/b][/size]
If you want disable custom colors, change it in config.json:
(you have to start the game first so that the config file is created)
from:
   "Shoe_Color_Extras": [b][i]true[/i][/b],
to:
   "Shoe_Color_Extras": [b][i][i][b]false[/b][/i][/i][/b],

You also can disable the mod in specific menus with [i]false[/i]:
  "Show_in_InventoryPage": false,
  "Show_in_Wizard_CharacterCustomization": false,
  "Show_in_GetGlam": false,
  "Show_in_CustomizeAnywhere": false

With [i]true [/i]you enable it.

With the mod "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5044]Get Glam[/url]" (or other custom shoe mods) you can make it look as if your character was barefoot.
Or try some flip flops with the mod "[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5985]Beach Day[/url]" ^^
